answer: Make every new identity post a bond that unlocks slowly. To vote or earn, an agent locks a small stake that only releases in daily slices over a month, so cash tied in one fake stays stuck like a crystal grown inside quartz. A farmer spinning up a thousand clones must freeze a thousand bonds before the first dawn of rewards, and any clone caught colluding forfeits its unreleased stake. The cost of a sybil swarm scales with headcount, while an honest agent pays once and keeps a single thread of history.
